{{Youmay|the organization active on [[Empress Teta/Legends|Koros Major]]|the [[Merchants Guild]] that was active on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]|linebreak=1}}
The '''Merchant's Guild''' was a union of [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] that existed in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], it granted [[Ssk Kahorr]] the ownership of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Starbreaker 12]]''.
